# Packet Examples

Complete example context packets for reference. These demonstrate the full shape of a
well-formed packet after Phase 1 synthesis.

---

## Example 1: Velocity (Developer Tool)

A CI/CD pipeline visualization tool targeting backend and platform engineers.
Dark-first design using the Neon Dashboard aesthetic with Ink neutrals and cyan accent.

```yaml
# --- AGENT CONTEXT PACKET ---
# Generated by: design-system-builder Phase 1 synthesis
# Version: 1.1

version: "1.1"

brand:
  name: "Velocity"
  domain: "velocity.dev"
  tagline: "Ship faster. Break nothing."
  industry: "developer tools"
  audience: "Backend and platform engineers at mid-size startups"
  trust_level: "medium"
  product_description: "CI/CD pipeline visualization and deployment orchestration"

creative_brief:
  statement: "Cold precision meets sudden warmth. Dense data surfaces stay calm under pressure while the hero gets one sharp atmospheric moment. Nothing decorative survives unless it helps orientation."
  philosophy: "This system believes deployment should feel controlled and refuses noisy cyberpunk aesthetics."
  art_direction_keywords: ["precise", "technical", "confident", "fast", "controlled"]
  risk_dial: "elevated"

aesthetic:
  origin: "Neon Dashboard"
  modifications: ["Ink neutral family", "cyan-only accent", "no purple secondary accent"]
  secondary_influences: ["Swiss grid discipline"]
  mood_keywords: ["precise", "technical", "confident", "fast"]

colors:
  neutral_family: "Ink"
  temperature: "cool"

  raw_palette:
    neutral_dark: "#09090B"
    neutral_dark_2: "#18181B"
    neutral_light: "#E4E4E7"
    neutral_light_2: "#D4D4D8"
    neutral_light_3: "#A1A1AA"
    line: "#27272A"
    line_strong: "#3F3F46"
    accent: "#22D3EE"
    accent_hover: "#06B6D4"
    accent_press: "#0891B2"
    accent_tint: "rgba(34,211,238,0.10)"
    accent_deep: "#0E7490"
    success: "#16A34A"
    warning: "#F59E0B"
    error: "#DC2626"
    info: "#0EA5E9"
    info_tint: "#F0F9FF"

  semantic_mapping:
    bg: "#09090B"
    bg_alt: "#18181B"
    bg_inverse: "#E4E4E7"
    bg_inverse_alt: "#D4D4D8"
    fg: "#E4E4E7"
    fg_muted: "#A1A1AA"
    fg_subtle: "#71717A"
    fg_on_dark: "#E4E4E7"
    fg_on_dark_muted: "#A1A1AA"
    accent: "#22D3EE"
    accent_hover: "#06B6D4"
    accent_press: "#0891B2"
    accent_tint: "rgba(34,211,238,0.10)"
    on_accent: "#09090B"
    border: "#27272A"
    border_strong: "#3F3F46"
    border_dark: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
    focus_ring: "#22D3EE"

  dark_mode:
    bg: "#09090B"
    bg_alt: "#18181B"
    bg_inverse: "#E4E4E7"
    fg: "#E4E4E7"
    fg_muted: "#A1A1AA"
    fg_subtle: "#71717A"
    accent: "#22D3EE"
    accent_hover: "#06B6D4"
    border: "#27272A"
    border_strong: "#3F3F46"

  raw_names:
    neutral_dark: "void"
    neutral_light: "chalk"
    accent: "cyan"
    line: "line"

typography:
  families:
    display: "Space Grotesk"
    display_fallbacks: "system-ui, sans-serif"
    body: "IBM Plex Sans"
    body_fallbacks: "system-ui, sans-serif"
    mono: "Fira Code"
    mono_fallbacks: "ui-monospace, monospace"

  scale_ratio: "1.25"

  language_strategy:
    primary_language: "English"
    secondary_languages: []
    script_system: "Latin"
    reading_direction: "ltr"
    cultural_typographic_notes: []

  expressive_roles:
    brand_mark: "Space Grotesk 700, tight tracking"
    hero: "Space Grotesk 700, -0.03em tracking"
    section_heading: "Space Grotesk 600"
    body: "IBM Plex Sans 400"
    ui_label: "IBM Plex Sans 500, 12px, wide tracking"
    data: "Fira Code 400, tabular"
    code: "Fira Code 400"

  font_rationale:
    display:
      font: "Space Grotesk"
      expresses: ["precision", "speed", "technical authority"]
      script_fit: "Geometric Latin forms suit developer-tool sharpness"
      use_for: ["hero", "section headings", "data callouts"]
      avoid_for: ["long body copy", "dense tables"]
    body:
      font: "IBM Plex Sans"
      expresses: ["clarity", "trust", "readability"]
      script_fit: "Optimized for Latin UI text with technical tone"
      use_for: ["body", "labels", "form text"]
      avoid_for: ["brand mark", "hero headlines"]
    mono:
      font: "Fira Code"
      expresses: ["engineering", "precision"]
      script_fit: "Monospace with ligatures for code display"
      use_for: ["code blocks", "terminal output", "data tables"]
      avoid_for: ["headings", "navigation"]

  levels:
    display:
      size: "72px"
      weight: "700"
      line_height: "1.05"
      letter_spacing: "-0.03em"
    h1:
      size: "48px"
      weight: "700"
      line_height: "1.1"
      letter_spacing: "-0.02em"
    h2:
      size: "32px"
      weight: "600"
      line_height: "1.15"
      letter_spacing: "-0.01em"
    h3:
      size: "24px"
      weight: "600"
      line_height: "1.2"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    h4:
      size: "20px"
      weight: "600"
      line_height: "1.3"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    body_lg:
      size: "18px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.6"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    body:
      size: "16px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.6"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    body_sm:
      size: "14px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.55"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    label:
      size: "12px"
      weight: "500"
      line_height: "1.3"
      letter_spacing: "0.08em"
    mono:
      size: "14px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.5"
      letter_spacing: "0"

  weights:
    regular: "400"
    medium: "500"
    semibold: "600"
    bold: "700"

spacing:
  base_unit: "4px"
  scale:
    "1": "4px"
    "2": "8px"
    "3": "12px"
    "4": "16px"
    "5": "24px"
    "6": "32px"
    "7": "48px"
    "8": "64px"
    "9": "96px"
    "10": "128px"
  container_max: "1280px"
  nav_height: "64px"
  nav_height_sm: "56px"

density_system:
  tier: "compact"
  spacing_multiplier: 0.85
  max_components_per_section: "7"
  section_padding_range: "32-64px"
  whitespace_attitude: "compressed but breathable around primary data"

radii:
  sm: "6px"
  md: "10px"
  lg: "14px"
  xl: "20px"
  full: "9999px"

shadows:
  sm: "0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.30)"       # dark-mode value; light mode uses 0.04-0.06 range
  md: "0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.40)"       # dark-mode value; light mode uses 0.08-0.12 range
  lg: "0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.50)"      # dark-mode value; light mode uses 0.12-0.16 range
  accent: "0 8px 24px rgba(34,211,238,0.24)"

motion:
  easing: "cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)"
  duration_micro: "100ms"
  duration_fast: "200ms"
  duration_base: "300ms"
  duration_slow: "450ms"

voice:
  profile: "Direct/Technical"
  example_words: ["ship", "deploy", "pipeline", "build", "monitor"]
  casing: "sentence case"
  headline_style: "short and punchy, max 6 words, action-oriented"
  body_style: "concise, technical, no fluff. 2-3 sentences max per paragraph."
  button_style: "action verbs, 1-2 words: Deploy, Run pipeline, View logs"
  good_example: "Your pipeline completed in 42 seconds. 3 tests passed, 0 failed."
  bad_example: "Great news! Your awesome pipeline has finished running successfully! :)"

imagery:
  photo_style: "none"
  illustration_style: "diagrammatic"
  color_treatment: "duotone"
  crop_rules: "wide cinematic hero only"
  subject_guidelines: "Diagrams, flowcharts, pipeline visualizations only. No lifestyle photography."

surfaces:
  - name: "marketing"
    components: ["Nav", "Hero", "Features", "Pricing", "Testimonials", "Footer"]
  - name: "dashboard"
    components: ["SidebarNav", "HeaderBar", "PipelineList", "BuildDetail", "DeployHistory", "Settings"]

components:
  character_rules:
    buttons: "Square-ish corners (radius-md), sentence-case label, filled primary uses on_accent text"
    cards: "1px zinc border at rest; 1px cyan top border on hover/active -- no box shadow"
    inputs: "Full 1px zinc border; focus state swaps to 1px cyan border with subtle glow"
    navigation: "Monochrome zinc until active; active item gets 2px cyan bottom border, no bg fill"
    sections: "Dark void (#09090B) alternating with slightly lifted bg_alt (#18181B); no pure white sections"
  component_style_contract:
    radius_language: "slightly-rounded"
    elevation_language: "flat"
    border_style: "full"
    density: "compact"
    button_primary:
      hover_color: "var(--accent-hover)"
      border_treatment: "none"
      transition: "all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)"
    button_focus:
      ring_color: "var(--focus-ring)"
      ring_width: "2px"
      ring_offset: "2px"
    button_disabled:
      opacity: "0.4"
      cursor: "not-allowed"
      pointer_events: "none"
    card_default:
      border: "1px solid var(--border)"
      hover_effect: "border-color: var(--accent); border-top: 2px solid var(--accent)"
      elevation: "none"
    card_featured:
      border: "2px solid var(--accent)"
      hover_effect: "box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.15)"
      elevation: "none"
    input_default:
      border: "1px solid var(--border)"
      background: "var(--bg)"
      radius: "var(--radius-md)"
    input_focus:
      ring_color: "var(--focus-ring)"
      ring_width: "1px"
      ring_offset: "0"
    input_error:
      border_color: "var(--error)"
      ring_color: "var(--error)"
    nav_active:
      indicator_style: "2px solid var(--accent) bottom border"
      color: "var(--accent)"
      background: "transparent"
    nav_mobile:
      breakpoint: "768px"
      treatment: "hamburger menu, slide-in drawer"
    sections:
      rhythm: "alternating --bg and --bg-alt"
      divider: "none"
  signature_propagation:
    - "Focus rings and selected nav states use the same cyan glow as the hero grid."
    - "Active data points in charts emit the calibrated cyan glow."
  canonical_sources: "foundations/components/ is canonical for component implementations"

constraints:
  framework: "plain HTML"
  accessibility_level: "WCAG AA"
  target_devices: "responsive"
  icon_library: "Lucide"
  icon_cdn: "https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"
  performance: "static HTML, no JS frameworks"
  font_stylesheet_url: "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Fira+Code:wght@400;500&display=swap"
  reading_direction: "ltr"
  locale: "en-US"
  date_format: "MM/DD/YYYY"
  number_format: "1,234.56"
  cultural_context: ""
  theme_modes:
    - "light"
    - "dark"
  default_mode: "dark"

global_context:
  reading_direction: "ltr"
  lang: "en"
  locale: "en-US"
  date_format: "MM/DD/YYYY"
  number_format: "1,234.56"
  cultural_context: ""
  font_loading: "CDN"
  icon_strategy: "Lucide via CDN"

substitutions:
  - item: "Display font"
    used: "Space Grotesk"
    reason: "No brand font provided. Selected from Neon Dashboard preset."
  - item: "Body font"
    used: "IBM Plex Sans"
    reason: "No brand font provided. Paired with Space Grotesk from preset."
  - item: "Accent color"
    used: "#22D3EE"
    reason: "No brand color provided. Using Neon Dashboard default cyan."
  - item: "Logo"
    used: "Text-based wordmark"
    reason: "No logo asset provided. Generating text lockup from brand name."
  - item: "Icons"
    used: "Lucide icon library"
    reason: "No custom icon set provided. Using Lucide as the default."

signature_anchor: "Calibrated cyan grid-glow -- a precise luminous grid that appears in hero, selected nav, and chart focus states"
signature_dna:
  - "Hero section -- full-bleed dark panel with a subtle cyan dot-grid overlay; glow intensity increases on scroll entry"
  - "Navigation -- selected item receives a 2px cyan underline plus a 4px radial glow; inactive items are monochrome zinc"
  - "Chart/data focus states -- active data point emits the same cyan glow, tying infrastructure and data surfaces to the same visual language"

signature_moment:
  concept: "calibrated grid glow"
  rationale: "Precision is the core trust signal for a CI/CD tool. A restrained cyan glow on the underlying grid implies the system is always watching and always accurate."
  placements: ["hero", "selected nav item", "chart active focus states"]
  constraints: "Never use glow on body text, dense table rows, or error states -- glow signals 'active/success', not 'warning'."
  systemic_effects:
    - "Focus rings on all interactive elements use the same cyan glow as the hero grid"
    - "Thin 1px grid lines appear as a subtle background texture on dark surfaces"
    - "Glow is reserved exclusively for active/selected states -- idle states are flat"

tension_points:
  scale: "Large technical display type (72px hero) against restrained 12px metadata labels"
  density: "Spacious hero followed by compact deployment table with compressed row spacing"
  structure: "Break the grid only in the hero diagnostic panel -- rest stays strict"
  implementation:
    scale_css: "6x ratio -- display (72px) vs label (12px)"
    density_css: "hero --space-10 padding vs table --space-2 row gap"
    structure_css: "hero uses 7fr 5fr asymmetric grid; body uses 12-col"

rule_breaking_budget:
  allowed_breaks: 1
  breakable_rules: ["type_scale"]
  allowed:
    - "Hero headline may use 72px display weight outside the standard scale"
  forbidden: ["forms", "tables", "accessibility states", "touch targets"]
  rationale: "One deliberate scale break in the hero creates the system's signature tension between precision and atmosphere."

intentional_gaps:
  - omitted: "Full competitor research notes"
    recovery: "Read research_evidence only if copy or positioning is blocked"

decision_log:
  - id: "D-001"
    decision: "Aesthetic: Neon Dashboard"
    rationale: "Developer tool audience expects dark, technical interfaces with data-dense surfaces."
    source: "Derived from brand industry + audience analysis"
    user_context_ref: "industry=developer tools; audience=platform engineers"
    principle_ref: "Functional fitness + trust signaling"
    accessibility_ref: "WCAG AA contrast on dark bg"
    research_ref: "n/a"
  - id: "D-002"
    decision: "Ink neutral family with cool temperature"
    rationale: "Zinc/ink neutrals reinforce technical precision. Warm neutrals would feel out of place for CI/CD tooling."
    source: "Derived from Neon Dashboard preset + brand analysis"
    user_context_ref: "industry=developer tools"
    principle_ref: "Semantic color harmony"
    accessibility_ref: "Verified contrast on #09090B background"
    research_ref: "n/a"
  - id: "D-003"
    decision: "risk_dial: elevated"
    rationale: "Developer tool can push beyond safe defaults. Calibrated glow adds memorability without sacrificing usability."
    source: "Derived from audience trust_level=medium and industry norms"
    user_context_ref: "trust_level=medium; audience=engineers"
    principle_ref: "Risk-appropriate visual distinction"
    accessibility_ref: "Glow never applied to body text or error states"
    research_ref: "n/a"
```

## Example 2: Meridian (Fintech Platform) — Format A `character_rules`

A wealth management platform targeting independent financial advisors.
Light-first design using the Sandstone neutral family with a deep indigo accent.
Demonstrates Format A (structured) `character_rules` with per-component sub-fields.

```yaml
# --- AGENT CONTEXT PACKET ---
# Generated by: design-system-builder Phase 1 synthesis
# Version: 1.1

version: "1.1"

brand:
  name: "Meridian"
  domain: "meridian.finance"
  tagline: "Clarity for every decision."
  industry: "fintech / wealth management"
  audience: "Independent financial advisors managing $10M–$500M AUM"
  trust_level: "high"
  product_description: "Portfolio analytics and client reporting platform for RIAs"

creative_brief:
  statement: "Understated authority. Numbers lead — not color, not animation, not decoration. Every surface is designed so advisors can find what they need in two seconds, then explain it to clients in one. Warmth lives in the typography and spacing, not in the palette."
  philosophy: "This system believes trust is built through restraint. Complexity is hidden, not eliminated."
  art_direction_keywords: ["authoritative", "measured", "legible", "warm", "dependable"]
  risk_dial: "safe"

aesthetic:
  origin: "Approachable Enterprise"
  modifications: ["Sandstone neutrals instead of cool grey", "deep indigo accent instead of corporate blue", "generous whitespace over compact density"]
  secondary_influences: ["Swiss editorial print layout"]
  mood_keywords: ["authoritative", "measured", "warm", "legible"]

colors:
  neutral_family: "Sandstone"
  temperature: "warm-neutral"
  dark_mode_strategy: "derived"
  dark_mode_treatment:
    shadow: "darker"
    border: "subtle"
    bg_tint: "warm"

  raw_palette:
    neutral_dark: "#1C1917"
    neutral_dark_2: "#292524"
    neutral_light: "#FAFAF9"
    neutral_light_2: "#F5F5F4"
    neutral_light_3: "#E7E5E4"
    line: "#D6D3D1"
    line_strong: "#A8A29E"
    accent: "#4338CA"
    accent_hover: "#4F46E5"
    accent_press: "#3730A3"
    accent_tint: "#EEF2FF"
    accent_deep: "#312E81"
    success: "#15803D"
    success_tint: "#F0FDF4"
    warning: "#B45309"
    warning_tint: "#FFFBEB"
    error: "#B91C1C"
    error_tint: "#FEF2F2"
    info: "#1D4ED8"
    info_tint: "#EFF6FF"

  semantic_mapping:
    bg: "#FAFAF9"
    bg_alt: "#F5F5F4"
    bg_inverse: "#1C1917"
    bg_inverse_alt: "#292524"
    fg: "#1C1917"
    fg_muted: "#57534E"
    fg_subtle: "#78716C"
    fg_on_dark: "#FAFAF9"
    fg_on_dark_muted: "#A8A29E"
    accent: "#4338CA"
    accent_hover: "#4F46E5"
    accent_press: "#3730A3"
    accent_tint: "#EEF2FF"
    on_accent: "#FFFFFF"
    border: "#D6D3D1"
    border_strong: "#A8A29E"
    border_dark: "#292524"
    focus_ring: "#4338CA"

  dark_mode:
    bg: "#1C1917"
    bg_alt: "#292524"
    bg_inverse: "#FAFAF9"
    fg: "#FAFAF9"
    fg_muted: "#A8A29E"
    fg_subtle: "#78716C"
    accent: "#6366F1"
    accent_hover: "#818CF8"
    border: "#292524"
    border_strong: "#44403C"

  raw_names:
    neutral_dark: "stone"
    neutral_light: "parchment"
    accent: "indigo"
    line: "line"

typography:
  families:
    display: "Playfair Display"
    display_fallbacks: "Georgia, serif"
    body: "Inter"
    body_fallbacks: "system-ui, sans-serif"
    mono: "JetBrains Mono"
    mono_fallbacks: "ui-monospace, monospace"

  scale_ratio: "1.250"

  language_strategy:
    primary_language: "English"
    secondary_languages: []
    script_system: "Latin"
    cultural_typographic_notes: []

  expressive_roles:
    brand_mark: "Playfair Display 700, wide tracking"
    hero: "Playfair Display 600, normal tracking"
    section_heading: "Inter 600, tight tracking"
    body: "Inter 400"
    ui_label: "Inter 500, 11px, wide tracking, uppercase"
    data: "JetBrains Mono 400, tabular-nums"
    code: "JetBrains Mono 400"

  font_rationale:
    display:
      font: "Playfair Display"
      expresses: ["authority", "trust", "editorial prestige"]
      script_fit: "Serif with high contrast strokes signals institutional credibility"
      use_for: ["hero", "report titles", "major section openers"]
      avoid_for: ["dense tables", "small UI labels"]
    body:
      font: "Inter"
      expresses: ["clarity", "legibility", "neutrality"]
      script_fit: "Optimized Latin UI face; excellent at small sizes for data"
      use_for: ["body", "labels", "forms", "all UI chrome"]
      avoid_for: ["brand mark", "editorial headers"]
    mono:
      font: "JetBrains Mono"
      expresses: ["precision", "data accuracy"]
      script_fit: "Tabular figures essential for numeric alignment in portfolio tables"
      use_for: ["financial data", "account numbers", "percentage changes"]
      avoid_for: ["headings", "navigation"]

  levels:
    display:
      size: "60px"
      weight: "700"
      line_height: "1.1"
      letter_spacing: "-0.02em"
    h1:
      size: "48px"
      weight: "600"
      line_height: "1.15"
      letter_spacing: "-0.01em"
    h2:
      size: "32px"
      weight: "600"
      line_height: "1.2"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    h3:
      size: "24px"
      weight: "600"
      line_height: "1.25"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    h4:
      size: "20px"
      weight: "600"
      line_height: "1.3"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    body_lg:
      size: "18px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.7"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    body:
      size: "16px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.65"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    body_sm:
      size: "14px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.55"
      letter_spacing: "0"
    label:
      size: "11px"
      weight: "500"
      line_height: "1.3"
      letter_spacing: "0.1em"
    mono:
      size: "14px"
      weight: "400"
      line_height: "1.5"
      letter_spacing: "0"

  weights:
    regular: "400"
    medium: "500"
    semibold: "600"
    bold: "700"

spacing:
  base_unit: "4px"
  scale:
    "1": "4px"
    "2": "8px"
    "3": "12px"
    "4": "16px"
    "5": "24px"
    "6": "32px"
    "7": "48px"
    "8": "64px"
    "9": "96px"
    "10": "128px"
  container_max: "1400px"
  nav_height: "72px"
  nav_height_sm: "60px"

density_system:
  tier: "comfortable"
  spacing_multiplier: 1
  max_components_per_section: "5"
  section_padding_range: "64-96px"
  whitespace_attitude: "generous — whitespace signals premium positioning"

radii:
  sm: "4px"
  md: "8px"
  lg: "12px"
  xl: "16px"
  full: "9999px"

shadows:
  sm: "0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)"
  md: "0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)"
  lg: "0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)"
  accent: "0 4px 16px rgba(67,56,202,0.14)"

motion:
  easing: "cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"
  duration_micro: "80ms"
  duration_fast: "160ms"
  duration_base: "240ms"
  duration_slow: "380ms"

voice:
  profile: "Trusted Advisor"
  example_words: ["clarity", "confidence", "growth", "portfolio", "allocation"]
  casing: "sentence case"
  headline_style: "declarative, max 8 words, no imperative verbs"
  body_style: "professional and human. 2-3 sentences max. Define jargon on first use."
  button_style: "action verbs, 1-3 words: Review, Export report, Schedule meeting"
  good_example: "Your client's allocation is 8.3% ahead of their 5-year target."
  bad_example: "Wow! Amazing news about your awesome portfolio performance!"

imagery:
  photo_style: "editorial"
  illustration_style: "none"
  color_treatment: "desaturated"
  crop_rules: "landscape 16:9 for hero; no portraits unless client-uploaded"
  subject_guidelines: "Architecture, landscapes, abstract geometry. No stock-photo handshakes."
  implementation:
    hero_treatment_css: "filter: saturate(0.6) brightness(1.0); border-radius: 0"
    card_image_css: "aspect-ratio: 16/9; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.7)"
    overlay_css: "background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(28,25,23,0.55) 0%, transparent 55%)"
    dark_mode_adjustment: "filter: brightness(0.8) saturate(0.5)"
    placeholder_css: "background: var(--bg-alt); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--fg-subtle)"

surfaces:
  - name: "marketing"
    components: ["Nav", "Hero", "ValueProps", "Testimonials", "Pricing", "Footer"]
  - name: "dashboard"
    components: ["SideNav", "HeaderBar", "PortfolioSummary", "AllocationChart", "HoldingsTable", "ClientList", "ReportExport"]

components:
  # FORMAT A — structured character_rules with per-component sub-fields.
  # Use Format A for full builds to give agents explicit CSS-level directives
  # instead of interpretable prose. More precise than Format B string shorthand.
  character_rules:
    required_categories: ["buttons", "cards", "inputs", "navigation", "sections"]
    rules:
      buttons:
        border_treatment: "radius-md (8px); primary is filled indigo; secondary uses 1.5px indigo outline on transparent bg"
        padding_asymmetry: "symmetric padding; inline padding 2× block padding (24px × 12px for default)"
        hover_behavior: "primary: darken to accent-press (translateY 0); secondary: fill accent-tint bg"
        elevation: "flat at rest; subtle shadow-sm on primary hover only"
      cards:
        border_treatment: "1px var(--border) at rest; no accent border — use shadow elevation instead"
        padding_asymmetry: "24px padding all sides; data cards use 20px top / 16px sides for tighter label alignment"
        hover_behavior: "shadow-md elevates from shadow-sm; border-color stays neutral — no color shift"
        elevation: "shadow-sm at rest; shadow-md on hover/focus"
      inputs:
        border_treatment: "1px solid var(--border) full-border; radius-md; no underline-only style"
        padding_asymmetry: "12px block, 14px inline — slightly more horizontal for readability at small sizes"
        hover_behavior: "border-color shifts to var(--border-strong) on hover; no animation"
        elevation: "flat; focus state adds 2px solid var(--focus-ring) outline, no box-shadow ring"
      navigation:
        border_treatment: "left sidebar nav; active item uses 3px solid indigo left border, no bg fill"
        padding_asymmetry: "14px block, 16px inline for nav items; icon + label gap is 10px"
        hover_behavior: "bg-alt fill on hover; transition 160ms ease; no underline shift"
        elevation: "sidebar is flat, no shadow; sits on bg-alt surface"
      sections:
        border_treatment: "no dividers; whitespace alone separates sections"
        padding_asymmetry: "64px block on standard sections; hero 96px; testimonials 80px"
        hover_behavior: "no hover states on sections"
        elevation: "alternating bg / bg-alt surfaces; never pure white, never pure black"
    validation: "Must cover all 5 categories"

  component_style_contract:
    radius_language: "rounded"
    elevation_language: "layered"
    border_style: "full"
    density: "comfortable"
    button_primary:
      hover_color: "var(--accent-press)"
      border_treatment: "none"
      transition: "all 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"
    button_focus:
      ring_color: "var(--focus-ring)"
      ring_width: "2px"
      ring_offset: "2px"
    button_disabled:
      opacity: "0.45"
      cursor: "not-allowed"
      pointer_events: "none"
    card_default:
      border: "1px solid var(--border)"
      hover_effect: "box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)"
      elevation: "var(--shadow-sm)"
    card_featured:
      border: "1.5px solid var(--accent)"
      hover_effect: "box-shadow: var(--shadow-accent)"
      elevation: "var(--shadow-sm)"
    input_default:
      border: "1px solid var(--border)"
      background: "var(--bg)"
      radius: "var(--radius-md)"
    input_focus:
      ring_color: "var(--focus-ring)"
      ring_width: "2px"
      ring_offset: "0"
    input_error:
      border_color: "var(--error)"
      ring_color: "var(--error)"
    nav_active:
      indicator_style: "3px solid var(--accent) left border"
      color: "var(--accent)"
      background: "transparent"
    nav_mobile:
      breakpoint: "1024px"
      treatment: "hamburger menu, slide-over panel"
    sections:
      rhythm: "64px padding-block; 96px hero"
      divider: "none"
      background: "var(--bg)"
      alternation: "var(--bg-alt)"
  signature_propagation:
    - "The 3px indigo left-border nav indicator reappears as the active state on sidebar filter items and selected table rows."
    - "The desaturated editorial image treatment repeats on client avatar headers and report cover pages."
  canonical_sources: "foundations/components/ is canonical for component implementations"

  accessibility_level: "WCAG AA"
  target_devices: "responsive"
  icon_library: "Lucide"

  font_stylesheet_url: "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap"

signature_anchor: "3px indigo left-border state indicator — a precise vertical rule that marks active/selected elements across nav, tables, and filters"
signature_dna:
  - "Sidebar navigation — active item has a 3px solid indigo left border; background stays transparent. No bg fill, no gradient."
  - "Data tables — selected row gets the same 3px indigo left border, creating a visual thread from nav to content."
  - "Filter panels — active filter chips inherit a 1.5px indigo left micro-rule on their container, propagating the state grammar to utility surfaces."

signature_moment:
  concept: "left-border state indicator"
  rationale: "High-trust financial interfaces need unmistakable, non-color-dependent state markers. A precise indigo line is legible under any ambient condition and communicates selection without relying on fill or animation."
  placements: ["sidebar nav active item", "selected table rows", "active filter chips"]
  constraints: "Never use the left-border mark for hover states — only for confirmed active/selected. Hover uses bg fill only."
  systemic_effects:
    - "The 3px rule propagates from nav to tables to filters, creating a coherent selection grammar"
    - "Indigo is reserved for confirmed active states — hover uses bg-alt, never the indigo accent"
```
